definitions.round: one look at the log list and at every tiled log in state usable or qualified, with the contact User-Agent; its time is its start
definitions.window: the 24 hours from the first round; a slot is a half hour of it counted from that round, and a slot is present when a round started in it
definitions.status: per log and per probe, the count of each answer over the rounds of the window: an HTTP status; `bad` (200 with a body that is not a checkpoint, or not a names tile of its width); `error` (no answer: a timeout, a reset, the round deadline); `skipped` (no such tile: the tree is smaller than a tile, or its size is a multiple of 256); `absent` (the probe never ran: the checkpoint failed)
definitions.checkpoint: GET <monitoring URL>checkpoint; 200 counts only when the body parses as a checkpoint
definitions.tail: GET tile/names/<the last full tile>, from that round checkpoint
definitions.partial: GET tile/names/<N>.p/<W>, the partial tile of that round checkpoint; a 404 can be the log replacing it by the full tile, which the static CT API allows
definitions.first_served: the lowest names tile the log answers 200 for, by binary search between tile 0 (404) and the tail (200), assuming one contiguous range; first and last over the window, and its move in tiles a day
definitions.entries_per_day: the growth of the tree size from the first to the last checkpoint of the window, per 86,400 s of round time
definitions.tail_age_min: the median over the rounds of the minutes from the round start to the Timestamp of the last entry of the last full tile
definitions.reliable: a log in state usable in every round of the window, whose checkpoint and last full names tile answered 200 in every round of the window, and that never answered 429
definitions.geomys: every answer of a Geomys log in the rounds: the checkpoint, tile 0 and the tail must answer 200 and no request may answer 429 (a partial tile may answer 404, see partial); and every Geomys window read must see no 429
definitions.geomys_window: Tuscolo2027h1 from 2026-10-26T12:00:00Z to 12:05:00Z, read by tiles-window.mjs; gz_bytes counts declared lengths only, gzip_local_bytes is the tiles gzipped here at level 6
definitions.overlap: for a 5-minute window inside the Kafka retention, picked at run time: each set is the distinct names (lower case, without a leading `*.`) of a log family (every usable shard of Sycamore, Willow, Tuscolo, Gouda), their union, the Kafka window of certstream_domains, and THC dump of the window day; a cell is the percentage of the row set that is in the column set, hashed by ct-window.mjs hashName
definitions.rates: ct-rates.mjs: entries a day of every log not rejected or retired, from two tree sizes 10 minutes apart, once per run; a run total sums the logs measured, so it is a lower bound when a log was not
definitions.verdict: PASS when at least 44 of the 48 slots are present, Geomys answered as `geomys` says, the reliable list is not empty, a whole Geomys window was read with no 429, and at least one overlap window holds all four families, an uncut Kafka window and THC day
